svg.title: Processor Atlas — Six processors explained
svg.desc: Six original illustrated diagrams show CPU instruction execution, GPU parallel tiles, TPU matrix accumulation, NPU local inference, LPU scheduled inference and DPU packet filtering. The diagrams are conceptual and their timings are not benchmarks.
